title: target-status/v2
description: targets/<id>/status/<date>-<n>.yaml (F03-Q5): a curator's target-level declaration — the D-33 status, which node is the root when the DAG has more than one sink, and (for a target with no target.yaml and no fidelity certificates) the pre-F11 claimable and fidelity fallbacks. v2 (F11-R12, 2026-09-11) renames D-9's second rung to screened-and-signed: v3.12 demoted back-translation to one input of the rung rather than the rung itself, and D-34 makes that a new version rather than an edit. Where a target carries target.yaml and fidelity certificates, F11-R3 and R4 derive both values and these two fields are ignored.

cause.description: reasoning and, for dormancy, the D-25 series values at declaration
